mode_motion_hold_binding.scope: Existing mandatory guard holds forward/yaw commands at zero before readiness; physical coasting is not assumed zero and remains covered by braking plus transition-position inflation

observed_shuttle_prediction.scope: Empirical observed spatial-lane periodic hypothesis, not identity reidentification or an arbitrary human-motion safety bound; unsupported cases retain restart tubes

pedestrian_static_center_filter.scope: Reject fitted pedestrian centers strictly inside known solid wall volumes at the measured lidar height; not online SLAM or a general semantic classifier

external_execution_camera.scope: Actual third-person Isaac camera frames during this physical execution; visualization-only, not a policy observation or replay

braking_risk_model.scope: Nominal command-level horizon with reaction and filter tail; not a measured physical worst-case stopping certificate
braking_risk_model.pedestrian_model: Observed stationary restart and moving speed-interval model

path_switch_reward_contract.scope: Spatial continuity penalty, not a topological homotopy or global optimality certificate

path_heading_execution_guard.scope: Empirical command-level stop/turn hysteresis, not a worst-case drift bound; actual tracking requires independent physics acceptance

global_path_continuation.scope: Optional candidate continuity, not a replacement for Astar, vendor NeuPAN, or a global optimality proof

upper_action_risk_cost_scope: Same risk weight and actual upper decision interval as integrated RL reward; forecast risk is not charged as whole remaining-route exposure
upper_wait_action_scope: Risk-priced stationary contingency with nominal braking-position uncertainty; unavoidable stop remains a fallback, not a safety certificate

upper_route_execution_features.scope: Observed current pose and previous accepted path only; nominal turn time is not a physical worst-case bound

transition_cost_scope: Empirical directed time-cost estimates; execution release still requires live feedback. The lower delay bound is the recorded minimum_mode_motion_hold_s, through the empirical maximum, not a certified physical worst-case bound.
